title: TAI exact-main installed controller refresh authority
objective: Refresh only the root-installed TAI release-controller wrapper from exact current main through the existing pinned production SSH authority, atomically update its attested digest, and restore preflight execution without widening pcactions sudo or production authority.
boundaries: The only production command is /tai refresh-controller current-main on issue 3365
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
The target must equal exact current main before transfer and again on the REG.RU host
The existing protected SSH host, root principal, private key and pinned host fingerprint authority are reused
Only /usr/local/sbin/pc-tai-release-controller and its sudoControllerSha256 attestation may change
The shared /run/lock/pc-tai-release-controller.lock must be held exclusively during refresh
The staged wrapper digest must equal the wrapper in the protected exact-main checkout
The existing authority digest must equal the installed pre-refresh controller digest
Controller and authority updates are rollback-protected and verified after replacement
No runner registration, runner service restart, Compose mutation, database mutation, model mutation or application deployment occurs
The pcactions sudoers rule remains restricted to the single installed controller path
No tenant, role, financial, veterinary, agronomic or autonomous write authority is widened
